short: Shakespeare’s tragedy about the prince of Denmark.
note: William Shakespeare’s tragedy Hamlet. In Act 1, scene 5, the prince tells Horatio that reality contains more than his philosophy encompasses.

short: A soldier wearing a North African-inspired uniform.
note: A member of an infantry unit modeled on French troops in North Africa. American Civil War Zouave units adopted distinctive uniforms including short jackets and loose trousers.
